title: Iceberg Blow – Mangolam 60ml
description:
Iceberg Blow – Mangolam 60ml
Various types of mangoes are mixed together to produce this exquisite and unique mango taste on the inhale, briefly followed by ice cool menthol on the exhale. The sensation when vaping this on a hot sunny day cannot be described!
Primary Flavours:
Mango, Menthol
Bottle Size:
60ml
Ratio:
70VG/30PG
Nicotine:
0mg
